title: Fraulein Doktor
writer: Vittoriano Petrilli, H.A.L. Craig, Alberto Lattuada
actors: Suzy Kendall, Kenneth More, Nigel Green
plot: During the First World War, female German spy Fraulein Doktor and her team of saboteurs plan to kill Lord Kitchener, obtain the Allied defense plans, and steal the new French mustard-gas formula.
